_about: Every clue, key and locked door in the game. unreal/place_clues.py puts them in the level as BP_Examinable actors. Coordinates are Unreal cm (z = height of the surface the thing sits on). TEST CLUES for now: the real story text replaces these later.

_fields.title / body: what the reading screen shows (no body = no reading screen)
_fields.journal: line added to the Tab journal the first time
_fields.gives_key / needs_key: key name; needs_key locks it until you have that key
_fields.objective: new objective line after using it
_fields.open_angle: how far a door swings (default 95; negative swings the other way)
_fields.shape: paper, key, book, door or room_door (see SHAPES in place_clues.py)

clues.title: A note on the bed
clues.body:
[TEST NOTE]

Bug,

If you're reading this, you came. I knew you would. The office key is still in this room. Don't let them see you take it.

- Cas
clues.journal: Cas left a note on the bed in Room 104. The office key is somewhere in her room.

clues.title: Office key
clues.body:
[TEST KEY]

A brass key on a cracked plastic tag.

OFFICE - DO NOT REMOVE FROM PREMISES
clues.journal: Found the office key on the dresser next to the TV.

clues.locked_text: Locked. There must be a key somewhere.

clues.title: Guest book
clues.body:
[TEST GUEST BOOK]

Years of names in different pens. One name in every year is circled in red.

Last October: Room 104 - C. Byrne. Circled.
clues.journal: The guest book has Cas's name circled in red. One name is circled every year.
clues.objective: Find the trail behind the motel.

clues.title: Back gate key
clues.body:
[TEST KEY]

A new key on a red tag, lying on the office desk. Someone wrote on the tag: GATE.
clues.journal: Found a key marked GATE on the office desk. The trail behind the motel starts at a locked gate.
clues.objective: Open the gate behind the motel.

clues.locked_text: A new chain and padlock. Someone wants this kept shut.
clues.objective: Follow the trail to the lake.

clues.title: Boathouse key
clues.body:
[TEST KEY]

A small new key on a loop of fishing line, lying on Cas's lake map. Someone drew a circle around the boathouse.
clues.journal: Found a new key on the map in the cabin by the lake. The boathouse is circled.

clues.locked_text: Padlocked. The lock is new. Everything else here is rotting.
